_comment: Constants for the CDJ analysis-folder index. See ANLZ_PATH.md.
index_formula: index = ((H0 + sum(ord(c_i) * W_i)) mod 2**32) mod 200003, i = offset from END of the USB-relative filename, 0-based

exact_32bit._scope: H0 is only ever pinned to a residue class mod 200003; candidates form a contiguous arithmetic progression of step 200003. Listed as (first, count).
exact_32bit._H0_note: all reproduce the 40 observations and agree on every prediction tried; any one may be used

_weights_note: end-offsets 4..19,21,23,25,27 known only mod 200003; 32-bit values needed to compute carries for arbitrary-length names
_P_note: P folder is a second, unsolved hash. Not a function of the index or of the raw 32-bit hash (searched shifts 0-31 x moduli 2-400).

.m4a._note: unanimous on ~2/3 of names; write both candidate indices for the rest

_why_wide: Intersecting observations cannot narrow H0 below its residue class: candidates are an arithmetic progression of step 200003, so only a sample straddling a 2**32 wrap discriminates. .mp3 took 39 samples to reach 5 candidates; .m4a has 7 and sits at 6414. Writing every distinct predicted index (at most 2, measured over the whole namespace) makes this immaterial.
P_hypotheses_ruled_out: bitfield of the raw 32-bit index hash (shifts 0-31 x moduli 2-400)
bucket/sub-bucket split of h = q*200003 + index (q%128, q>>7, q>>8, q%121, ...)
stock hash of the path: CRC32, Adler32, FNV-1, FNV-1a, djb2, djb2-xor, sdbm, Java, byte-sum -- across 4 path forms x every shift x moduli {128,127,121,200,256}
linear mod 128 (fails on T123 given T000/T001/T010/T100, same batch, identical audio)

ANY bitfield of ANY linear hash of the path: solving the 9-sample offset-4 group over a 2^22 grid of the weight gives zero feasible values. Middle-bit extractions reduce to the same model with a different modulus, so they are covered too. This rules out every polynomial/rolling hash, since those are linear in the characters.
Beatty function of the index, floor(128*frac(index*theta)) over a 2^24 theta grid (best 6/41 vs 0.3 chance -- just the max of 16M trials)
scanned rather than computed: analysis placed at the correct index under a deliberately wrong P (TA1B at P001, true P016) was NOT found -- the player re-analysed and wrote its own at P016
_P_conclusion: P is computed from the path and is not linear in the characters. It is not stored anywhere (analyze_path is ignored; USBMNG holds only the ANLZ file number), so the player must re-derive it on every read. Writing all 128 P000-P07F folders at the computed index is confirmed working and remains the correct workaround; ui/duckbox-learn pins the real folder per track afterwards to drop the 128x storage cost.
